temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that Christian is right: he has been keeping something from him and is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed: Jonathan is indeed hiding something, and it is serious enough that he calls it trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is hiding something important and is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Get Jonathan to explain the truth and understand what trouble he is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he did not want to drag Christian into it, but he accepts that he could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in some kind of trouble and has been hiding it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and is willing to accept Christian's help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs support and resources to get out of his mess, and Christian can help him face it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer help and support Jonathan in finding a way out.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, admits he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself. Christian says he will look into it discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble may be related to some kind of criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Partially confirmed: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people, but he claims he did not do anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with dangerous or criminal people, and the truth needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Investigate the matter discreetly without alarming Jonathan and ensure his safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed. He tells Jonathan someone is setting him up and that he has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people, but he claims he did nothing illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: evidence indicates Jonathan is not guilty but is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed, and Christian must gather evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gather more evidence to clear Jonathan's name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian learns that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, someone they both know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: the framing is not by an unknown outsider but by a trusted person close to both of them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is responsible for framing Jonathan and must be brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront the real culprit and make sure they are brought to justice.
